title: Chapter 468
paragraphs: Chapter 468
Episode 132. Massacre and Strange… (2)
Murakan did not forgive Sandra Zipfel's rudeness.
He didn't need to ask Jin for permission or choose his words carefully.
All he needed to do was make her pay for her displeasure.
Swoosh…!
The lingering flames around Sandra, Yeonggi, and Cheonghwa swayed according to Murakan's will.
Without making a sound, the flames soon transformed into needle-like shapes.
They rushed towards Sandra as fast as a descending hawk.
There were eight of them. Most of the Zipfel wizards were nearly exhausted from dealing with the fire all this time, so they couldn't even react.
A few wizards, including Midor, noticed Murakan's attack but did not step forward.
They didn't want to put themselves in danger by trying to help her.
Surprisingly, Sandra managed to dodge three of the eight needles.
She displayed agility and light movements, unlike a typical wizard, and neutralized another three with a protective barrier.
However, the remaining two were a problem.
"Ugh!"
One pierced Sandra's shoulder, and the other her calf. The sight of flesh and blood spurting out indicated serious injuries.
Murakan looked down at Sandra, who was lying on the ground, trembling.
Inflicting serious injuries on a pure-blooded Zipfel without a second thought.
It was something that could only be done with a certain amount of authority, and it meant that he could wage an all-out war against the entire Zipfel family.
At least, the members of other powerful forces watching Murakan had no choice but to think that way.

'The acting head of the family, Black Leopard Rosa Runcandel, said she would pursue him… Could it be that Murakan not only symbolizes the guardian deity but also holds real power in Runcandel? More power than the acting head of the family?'
'In fact, the acting head of the Runcandel family might actually be the Black Dragon Murakan…'
'Then what is the hierarchy of the 12 riders?'

'Anyway, Sandra Zipfel is done for. She dared to provoke him after witnessing the top White Wolf warrior die in an instant, leaving only his ankle… Has she become numb to fear after living in Zipfel for too long?'
The special agents were thinking that way.
The White Wolf and Red Tiger tribes of Kinzelos couldn't think at all. They were simply terrified and looking around in all directions.
'Sandra Zipfel isn't the only one who's finished. The Zipfel support troops were our only hope for survival…!'
Ratz's eyes trembled.
No one could survive, and Ratz was now certain that Murakan's words earlier were not mere bluster.
With the agents currently here, they couldn't even inflict significant damage on Murakan, let alone fight him.
Ratz decided that their only option for survival was to rely on Zipfel.
Sandra didn't activate her staff of Matopju, and she was severely injured in an instant.
She was going to die soon.
Ratz felt like screaming.
The Matopju staff isn't for Sandra, but for you - no, for Midor Elner. Activate the staff, he wanted to say.
[I didn't kill you instantly because I was curious about the source of your arrogance and heaviness. A puppet? A doll maker? Speak again, Zipfel.]
The members of the powerful forces felt chills once more from the cold, low voice.
"Hoo, hoo."
Sandra gasped for breath. They assumed her breathing was faster due to the fear of death.
However, she was just a little more surprised by the pain than she had expected.
Creak, creak…
Suddenly, there was a sound like gears turning somewhere.
The sound came from Sandra. And everyone looking at her had to doubt their own eyes.
Her pierced shoulder and thigh were rapidly healing.
'Healing? A human is healing!'
The White Wolf and Red Tiger tribes had never seen a human regenerate like that.
On the other hand, Ratz and the agents opened their eyes wide, feeling embarrassed.
'Has Zipfel's biological experiment already advanced to that level? It's on par with the Mine procedure that the royal guards received!'
Biological experiments.
Zipfel, Vermont, and Kinzelo had been conducting biological experiments for a long time.
Zipfel aimed to create the perfect biological golem, Vermont aimed to create Mines, and Kinzelo aimed to create masters.
Vermont was confident that they were clearly leading in biological experiments.
Although it was still in the experimental stage and had many unstable aspects. As proven by the fact that former royal guard leader Rik Heltar lost his reason after transforming into a Mine.
However, Sandra's rapid regeneration was similar to a Mine while maintaining her sanity.
In Ratz's opinion, it was impossible without a biological golem procedure and that procedure being superior to the Mine transformation magic developed by the empire.
'It's highly possible that there is someone within the empire leaking information to Zipfel…'
As Ratz gritted his teeth, he watched Sandra regenerate one step behind.
Jin had just escaped from the broken core of the device while erasing his presence as much as possible with his spirit.
It seemed necessary to personally check the situation as it unfolded.
'...Recovery? Regeneration?'

I never could have imagined that I would see rapid regeneration from Sandra as well, following Amela. As Murakan mentioned while looking at Amela, rapid regeneration is usually exclusive to demons or magical creatures.
Amela had the special power of chaos and energy, which was even amplified, so it was possible for her.
'Did Sandra also inherit chaos? It doesn't seem like she would have been so defenseless against the energy if she had.'
As Jin thought, Sandra was an ordinary human who wasn't tainted by chaos.
And while others didn't notice it,
In Jin's view, Sandra's rapid regeneration was somewhat different from the methods he had experienced so far.
'Sandra's rapid regeneration doesn't feel like the wound itself is healing, but rather like the time around the wound is rewinding.'
He wasn't sure. The wound healed too quickly, and he was too far away to see it clearly.
Sandra Zipfel.
Jin had never crossed paths with her in this life.
However, in his previous life, he had accidentally encountered her.
They had exchanged a few words about magic while waiting for Valeria at a fountain.
-Regarding the 3-stage classification of magic by Metu Morniac? Wow, you're reading an interesting book? It's hard to find.
-Who are you?
-Normally, people mistakenly know Metu Morniac as Metu Worniac, so they read the books by frauds. You seem to be careful not to be deceived anywhere.
-Do you know me?
-I'm not so stupid as to be deceived, but sometimes I know and just let myself be fooled. It's cute, isn't it?
'It was about a year later that I found out that she was Sandra Zipfel.'
He thought she was just one of the many magic students commonly found in places like parks, but he was surprised when he recognized her face in a newsletter.
'Looking back, I wonder if that was an intentional approach. She must have been curious about how miserable the expelled Runcandel was living, and why he was lurking in the mage's territory.'
His connection with Sandra was all there was.
That's why Jin didn't worry too much about her in this life.
She didn't make a name for herself as a mage like Kelliark's other children, nor did she contribute to the family as a Matopju.
Just looking at the mages from Zipfel who came to Gaipa Territory, the highest external rank was Midor Elner, the 7th Matopju.
In other words, she was a pure-blooded Zipfel in the second tier of Runcandel or even lower.
However, seeing Sandra's attitude and Midor's gaze, anyone could tell that Sandra actually held a higher rank than Midor.
'Like Octavia Zipfel, did she deliberately hide her power and abilities? I thought not all of them would be like Octavia, but Sandra is quite surprising.'
The reason Jin found Sandra surprising was none other than this.
The reason he learned about the fact that the woman who spoke to him at the fountain was Sandra was because the content of the newsletter article that informed him was about a 'marriage.'
In Jin's previous life, she had a strategic marriage with a lower-ranking royalty of the Vermont Empire.
It was a method widely used not only by Zipfel but also by various forces in the world. Marrying off 'side-branch' children like this to make alliances or resolve other issues.
'I can't think of any reason why Sandra would have a strategic marriage if she was a hidden powerhouse in my previous life as well. She could have retired or been in hiding like Octavia.'
At that moment, when Jin thought that far, Sandra opened her mouth.
"Ah, this is too painful. Um, I don't quite understand, but was my remark offensive to you, Murakan?"
[What?]

"I stopped our junior from activating the Matopju staff because I was worried about the 12th flagbearer and Murakan. I just wanted to meet and fight Jin Runcandel, but I'm curious if that's really so offensive!"
Sincerely, Sandra.
She thought there was no problem with expressing herself as a puppeteer or a marionette. To her, it's just a fact that she couldn't differentiate between pleasure and displeasure.
It was in the same context as talking to Midor as if nagging.
"Rather, it's something you should be praised for. I know the Black Dragon is strong, but I think avoiding trouble is the best policy for anyone. Right?"
At that point, even Murakan couldn't help but be at a loss for words for a moment.
It was inevitable to think, what is this all about...? looking at Sandra, who was speaking so calmly.
"Well, that's not wrong."
Jin revealed himself and spoke.
Continuing to deal with her could actually undermine Murakan's dignity.
That's why he decided it was better for him to handle it. He also needed to check more closely what form of rapid regeneration it was.
"Oh! Jin Runcandel!"
Sandra's eyes sparkled as she exclaimed.
"Do you want to fight me?"
The gazes of the two met.
And at the moment when Sandra was about to nod and say yes,
Whoosh!
Jin quickly closed the distance and thrust the Bradamante into Sandra's collarbone.
"It seems you're a bit lacking for that, Sandra Zipfel."
Before pulling out the blade that pierced her collarbone, Crick!
A sound like a cogwheel turning scraped against his ears.
